_about: Shelter & stray fragment (List 23 #220) — custody for individuals with no current keeper. Custody is NOT keeping: intake rewrites no keeper seat. The shelter is a centre-class seat (#132 family, #193 custody discipline): its only writes are intake records, custody relocations, transfer stamps via #217, and its own service record. Reunion is identification by the individual's own #80/#168 history — no separate lost-and-found database exists.
custody_record: {individualId, class: surrender | stray, intakeBeat (#12 ref), foundAt (stray: place + beat), seeking: bool (a recorded keeper is seeking this individual), shelterSeat} — service record beside the individual, per #193's pattern

exits.adoption: second exit — #217's adoption class (shelter as from, history fully legible); CLOSED while seeking stands open
exits.reunion: primary exit — custody release, no keeper change (the keeper never changed); identification is the record's keeper history itself

intake.stray: found without their keeper; where/when recorded in #12 beat terms; everything preserved (honours, deviations, care history)
intake.surrender: a keeper gives an individual into custody; the intake entry names the surrendering keeper; history gains a custody entry, not a keeper change

open_register: whether surrender carries a #104 occasion (proposal into #104's home)
shelter seat in #106's location vocabulary (proposal — its home disposes)

special_clauses.dark_forest: strays are taken in at the Forest's EDGE only; no intake class is a retrieval from the depths (#163 — the depths table is empty; no rescue-expedition shape exists in this format)

writes: vitality via #132 centre business (the one centre write)
